title: tRPC #7336: React 19 proxy coercion causes infinite recursion in createInnerProxy

error_signal.message: trpc TypeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded when React 19 calls valueOf() or toString() on tRPC proxy object returned by createInnerProxy

ground_truth.root_cause_description: React 19 coerces proxy objects to primitives by calling valueOf/toString/toJSON. createInnerProxy's get trap returns another proxy for these methods instead of a primitive, causing infinite recursion.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add special handling for valueOf, toString, toJSON in the proxy get trap to return proper primitive values
